name: dify-template
title: Dify CALL-E workflow template
description: Importable Dify workflow DSL that validates one authorized CALL-E phone task, performs a read-only API preflight, supports dry-run preview, creates one live call only when requested, polls for completion, and returns a masked human-readable status and summary report.
side_effects: Creates one outbound phone call when dry_run=false, a valid CALL-E API key is configured, an authorized E.164 phone number is provided, and GET /v1/goals?limit=1 returns a 2xx status code.
Runs the documented, read-only GET /v1/goals?limit=1 API preflight during dry-run and live runs.
credentials: CALL-E API key stored as the Dify secret environment variable CALL_E_API_KEY before execution.
safety: Requires explicit dry_run=false before creating a live call.
Blocks live-call creation when the documented API preflight returns a non-2xx status code.
Prepends non-overridable phone-call safety boundaries before custom task text reaches CALL-E.
Uses a stable idempotency key derived from request_id and call inputs for replay safety.
Reports a 2xx create or poll response without a documented CallTask as unknown and possibly created, and requires replay or reconciliation with the same idempotency key.
Reports indeterminate create transport and force-failed HTTP outcomes as unknown and possibly created, and preserves the original idempotency key for reconciliation.
Masks E.164, common US-style, and grouped international phone numbers, including display formats with parentheses, in summaries and raw result output.
